title: Outcome record
description: Summary of the course of one patient in one scenario, derived from the event, alert and observation records. One record per scenario and patient. Days count from therapy start (day 1).

scenario_id.title: Scenario
scenario_id.description: Identifier of the intervention scenario, as in the scenario table.

follow_up_days.title: Follow-up
follow_up_days.description: Length of follow-up: until death or the end of the simulated period.

high_risk_flag.title: Flagged as high risk
high_risk_flag.description: The risk prediction at therapy start flagged the patient as high risk. False in scenarios without risk-adapted start.

participating.title: Taking part
participating.description: The patient takes part in at least one component of the scenario.

severe_toxicity_90d.title: Severe toxicity in 90 days
severe_toxicity_90d.description: At least one adverse event of CTCAE grade 3 to 5 recognised within 90 days of therapy start.

severe_toxicity_day.title: Day of severe toxicity
severe_toxicity_day.description: Day of the first adverse event of grade 3 to 5. Null if there was none within 90 days.

ild.title: Lung toxicity
ild.description: Drug-related interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis of any grade that started during follow-up.

ild_onset_day.title: Day of lung toxicity
ild_onset_day.description: Day on which the interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis actually started. Null if there was none.

ild_diagnosis_day.title: Day lung toxicity was recognised
ild_diagnosis_day.description: Day on which it was recognised. Null if there was none or if it was not recognised during follow-up.

ild_grade.title: Grade of lung toxicity
ild_grade.description: Highest CTCAE grade of the interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis. Null if there was none.

cv_event.title: Cardiovascular event
cv_event.description: Major adverse cardiovascular event under androgen deprivation during follow-up: myocardial infarction, stroke or cardiovascular death, i.e. a cardiovascular event of grade 3 to 5.

cv_event_1y.title: Cardiovascular event in the first year
cv_event_1y.description: Major adverse cardiovascular event within 364 days (52 weeks) of therapy start.

cv_onset_day.title: Day the cardiovascular event began
cv_onset_day.description: Day on which the event or its warning phase started. Null if there was none. Set also when the warning phase was treated in time and no major event followed.

cv_event_day.title: Day of the cardiovascular event
cv_event_day.description: Day of the major cardiovascular event. Null if there was none.

cv_grade.title: Grade of the cardiovascular event
cv_grade.description: CTCAE grade at which the cardiovascular event was recognised. Grades 1 and 2 are a warning phase treated in time. Null if there was none.

treatment_end_day.title: Day of therapy end
treatment_end_day.description: Day on which the therapy ended. Null if it was still ongoing at the end of follow-up.

death_day.title: Day of death
death_day.description: Day of death. Null if the patient was alive at the end of follow-up.

death_from_toxicity.title: Death from toxicity
death_from_toxicity.description: The patient died from an adverse event of grade 5.

hospital_days.title: Hospital days
hospital_days.description: Days in hospital because of adverse events.

icu_days.title: Intensive care days
icu_days.description: Days in intensive care because of adverse events.

unplanned_visits.title: Unplanned visits
unplanned_visits.description: Unplanned outpatient visits because of adverse events.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Number of alerts of the monitoring components.

false_alerts.title: False alerts
false_alerts.description: Number of alerts without a developing adverse event.

cost_care.title: Cost of care
cost_care.description: Costs of unplanned visits, hospital stays and diagnostics after alerts. Without the costs of the cancer drugs.

cost_intervention.title: Cost of the intervention
cost_intervention.description: Costs of risk assessment, set-up, monitoring and the handling of alerts.

qaly.title: Quality-adjusted life years
qaly.description: Life years during follow-up, weighted by quality of life.
